It does not cover full tuition or living costs on its own. You will still need to fund the rest of your tuition and all living costs.

- **Amount**: €5,000, paid once in the first year of study.
- **Coverage**: Does not cover full tuition or living costs.
- **Eligibility**: Nationality outside the EEA, applying for a full-time bachelor's or master's at a participating institution, and not previously studied in the Netherlands.
- **Application**: Apply directly to the university; application is free.

For more detailed information, you can visit the [official NL Scholarship page](https://www.studyinnl.org/finances/nl-scholarship).
